title: RNG game ideas prototyped by AI
author: Important_Luck_3546
selftext:
Recently there was a post about finding [what is missing from Steam](https://www.reddit.com/r/aigamedev/comments/1xcuxp3/i_mapped_all_189495_steam_games_to_find_whats/). In that post a unique idea was a house cleaning game. I thought that a random number generator probably comes up with more unique ideas than that algorithm.

So I put it to the test. The prompt was essentially "Generate game ideas by pairing popular Steam genres and adding a random theme. Turn the first 25 into realistic 5-second gameplay clips. Create concept art to use as a reference".

  
The next 5 ideas:

* Gothic - Third-Person Shooter x RTS
* Magic - Shoot 'Em Up x Rhythm
* Mining - Board Game x Bullet Hell
* Dark Fantasy - Survival x Farming Sim
* Western - Roguelike x Immersive Sim
* Fishing - Visual Novel x City Builder
* Rome - Top-Down Shooter x Dating Sim
* Space - City Builder x Third-Person Shooter

comments.author: Ok-Investment4414
comments.body: it wasn't bad , did a similar search based on that post you mentioned , went for likelihood of sales instead . Think that's a better metric that just adding to steams catalogue .
